bluf: High foot-traffic Saturday driven by three concurrent major events within 2 miles of property. ESB-MACC Grand Reopening (600 River St, 0.4 mi) draws 2,000–5,000+ with full 11 AM–9 PM programming — Rainey Street corridor will be densely congested all day. NCAA Super Regionals (Texas vs. Oregon, 7 PM ESPN, Disch-Falk) brings 7,000-cap crowd with post-game spillover 9:30–11 PM. Monster Jam (Moody Center, 7 PM) draws family crowds to UT corridor. Post-trial weekend recess: Karmelo Anthony trial on break Saturday/Sunday — monitor for verdict-reactive demonstrations at Capitol/Congress Ave. Flash Flood Watch expired; residual road impacts on low-lying approaches. FIFA WC soft-target and cyber advisory window remains active through June 11.

incidents.title: ESB-MACC Grand Reopening — Juntos de Nuevo
incidents.location: 600 River St, Austin TX (0.4 mi NE of property)
incidents.detail: The Emma S. Barrientos Mexican American Cultural Center officially reopens today after nearly three years of renovation. Free, no-ticket event runs 11 AM–9 PM with live music on three stages, artisan market, food trucks, and ribbon-cutting at 11 AM. Projected attendance 2,000–5,000+. No dedicated on-site parking — overflow directed to Holly St neighborhood and Convention Center Garage (601 E 5th). Rainey Street corridor and Ann & Roy Butler Hike & Bike Trail will see significantly elevated pedestrian traffic throughout the day and into evening. Coincides with Waterloo Greenway Confluence reopening. Expect increased foot traffic on San Jacinto Blvd, valet queue congestion, and rideshare/taxi surges especially 10 PM–11:30 PM.

incidents.title: NCAA Baseball Super Regionals — Texas vs. Oregon, Game 1
incidents.location: UFCU Disch-Falk Field, 1 Nolte Dr (1.8 mi E of property)
incidents.detail: Game 1 of the best-of-3 Super Regional series: #6 Texas Longhorns vs. #11 Oregon Ducks. 7 PM CT first pitch, live on ESPN. Stadium capacity ~7,000. Parking lots open ~5 PM; UT-area parking and Red River/I-35 corridor expect significant pre-game congestion 5–7 PM and post-game dispersal 9:30–11 PM. Alcohol sales in-venue; expect elevated late-night bar activity on 6th Street and East Austin corridors post-game. Game 2 Sunday 8 PM; Game 3 Monday if necessary.

incidents.title: Monster Jam — Moody Center ATX
incidents.location: 2001 Robert Dedman Dr (2.3 mi N of property)
incidents.detail: Monster Jam runs Saturday and Sunday at Moody Center. Saturday: Parking 4 PM, Pit Party 4:30 PM (separate ticket), Doors 6 PM, Show 7 PM. Expected family crowd 10,000+. UT campus and Guadalupe St ('The Drag') will see heavy vehicle and pedestrian traffic 4–10 PM. Post-event dispersal will compound I-35 congestion alongside Super Regionals crowd. Impact to property: valet advisory for east/north-bound guests; recommend Cesar Chavez or 5th St routing.

incidents.title: South Austin Homicide — Joseph George Charged (Duc Vo Murder)
incidents.location: Packed Saddle Pass / W Benno Blvd, South Austin (~6 mi S)
incidents.detail: APD arrested Joseph George (68) for the murder of Duc Vo (59), whose body was found concealed in a trash can. Surveillance video placed George at scene; he admitted to helping conceal the body for $50. Charged with murder and evidence tampering; bond $250,000. No Four Seasons nexus. South Austin residential area. Awareness item — ongoing APD homicide case trending locally.

civil_unrest.title: Karmelo Anthony Trial — Weekend Recess (Day 3 Monday)
civil_unrest.location: Collin County Courthouse, McKinney TX (~200 mi NE) / Austin Capitol area
civil_unrest.detail: Trial on weekend recess; resumes Monday. Day 2 (Fri) featured highly emotional testimony: prosecution showed jury Anthony's bloody jacket; Coach Vincent Hooper testified Anthony appeared 'genuinely distressed and cried' at the scene. SRO bodycam footage showed Anthony's first words: 'He put his hands on me, I told him no.' Jury has no Black members — ongoing controversy; demonstrators outside courthouse reported clashing. Verdict-reactive protest watch for Austin remains active — monitor Capitol/Congress Ave corridor and social media for mobilization. Trial expected through ~June 16–20.

civil_unrest.title: Round Rock Pride Festival
civil_unrest.location: Centennial Plaza, 301 W Baghdad St, Round Rock TX (~25 mi N)
civil_unrest.detail: 5th annual Round Rock Pride Festival, 2–7 PM. Free, family-marketed event. Texas Scorecard and conservative groups have flagged potential conflict with Texas law re: 'sexually oriented performances in front of minors' due to drag performers (Cynthia Lee Fontaine, Weird City Sisters). City Mayor and Councilmember giving opening remarks despite opposition. Counter-protest activity possible. No direct Austin downtown nexus but monitor for social media spillover and any incidents that could energize local activist networks.
